roar_of_love.readme.folder:
Roar of Love audio folder (mod by bilibili: JiaJiaBuHao)

[About sounds] Custom audio packs (zip override) were removed in 2.0.
Vanilla hurt / TNT / bow / anvil / XP / break / lava sounds are replaced by the mod built-in sounds.json and work out of the box.

[What this folder is for]
  1. Subtitle files: drop a .txt here, then pick it in Subtitle Settings - Load custom lines.
     Format: one line per category, like  lust: line1/line2  (lust/anim/peak/self/oral); # starts a comment.
  2. To replace action sounds, use the vanilla resource pack system (put packs into resourcepacks).

Rejoin the world to apply.
roar_of_love.readme.calls:
Put begin1.ogg ~ begin10.ogg and end.ogg here (a random begin each second during animation, end when it stops).
Subfolders self/ and oral/ are the masturbation and oral groups.
(mod by bilibili: JiaJiaBuHao)
